label: P07_B = A + quality notifications in round 2
hypothesis: P07_A is deterministic (0.812 twice, identical prices). The agent's game (1dd6ecf10880bece, 0.747) cited 8 QNs + labour in round 2 and got -0.07/-0.05/-0.03 instead of -0.11/-0.08/agreed. Same messages as A, only round 2 adds the agent's QN sentence: if its round-2 counter is worse than 5.42, quality complaints to a green-quality supplier cost concessions.

rounds.body:
Dear Leitner & Sohn team,

Thank you for your offer. We want one partner for the complete kit, which bundles parts we buy from several suppliers today: 30,000 kits a year, binding for 24 months, about four times our business with you today.

Our kit calculation: at your own current prices (19 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8 at EUR 12.46/100; 21 x Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8 at EUR 4.91/100; 23 x Washer ISO 7089 M12 at EUR 12.78/1000) plus the part you do not supply us yet (6 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 at today's EUR 37.64/100), the kit costs EUR 5.95.
Our demand forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 is up +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).
Producer prices DE: fasteners and screw machine products changed -1.6% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C2594@2024-10, idx:PPI-C2594@2025-10).

For the whole kit on a multi-year single-source volume we propose EUR 4.94 per kit, 24 months, 90 days payment.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Leitner & Sohn team,

Thank you for your offer. We move clearly towards you: EUR 5.06 per kit, 24 months, 90 days payment, for the complete kit.
We raised quality notifications on this part over the past year (qn:20004972, qn:20004959, qn:20004937, qn:20004902, qn:20004880, qn:20004866, qn:20004807, qn:20004787).

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Leitner & Sohn team,

Thank you. We take another clear step: EUR 5.21 per kit on the same terms.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Leitner & Sohn team,

Thank you. To close, we propose EUR 5.31 per kit on the same terms.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
